arcSummary: Yara was a king's forester until the day she was ordered to look the other way. She quit instead. She has never said what she saw.

stages.title: What She Saw
stages.summary: Crown survey markers on the route — the same kind she was ordered to ignore. She stops pretending she hasn't been watching for them.

stages.title: The Stand She Didn't Take
stages.summary: The ground she was marched away from is a day off the route. She has been a quiet passenger long enough.

stages.title: A Warden's Oath
stages.summary: She has written an oath for the guild's scouts and wardens. It is three words long.
